public_rationale: The commitments included watermarking and were voluntary undertakings by seven companies. Their terms did not bind independent developers or prohibit those developers from creating misinformation software. This supports the contextual claim about outside actors. The documents do not support a stronger claim that safeguards could have no indirect benefit.
limitations: The result depends on reading do nothing as no direct constraint on independent development.
Voluntary status and limited participation jointly explain the gap; the documents do not isolate voluntariness as the sole cause.
Some technical safeguards could make misuse harder.

our_interpretation: The referent is the July 21, 2023 White House commitments.
Rolling their own means independent development by actors outside the participating companies.
The plain contextual reading is that these commitments impose no binding restriction on independent developers. It is not a claim that every safeguard has zero indirect benefit.
Because they are voluntary is the proposed causal explanation, not an unfulfilled forecast condition.
